probes.description: REG-340: AwaitPaymentInRound (a timed, payload-matched awaitEvent inside a forEach round, the shape of ride-hailing's offer wait) parks (WAITING_EVENT). The 2 s resume sweep looks at it and finds nothing. 5 s later a SECOND flow (ConfirmPaymentByFlow) resumes it with an emitEvent step carrying the awaited payload reference. The parked execution must be COMPLETED within a couple of seconds, not 20 s later when the sweep reaches it.

steps.name: a second flow emits PaymentConfirmed under that correlation, 5 s after the park
the parked flow completed (retries cover only a short, bounded lag)
